content_zh:
——————————————
徐炎是真的没想到这一路和自己抽烟闲聊的苏沐,会是黑山镇的副镇长?等等,他这才多大,怎么就能成为副科级干部?
“我说兄弟,没骗我吧?”徐炎笑道。
“骗你有好处吗?”苏沐淡然道:“再说我的身份只要到了黑山镇,随便一查便能查到,现在骗你,至于吗?”
“说的倒是!”徐炎摸着脑袋讪讪笑道:“兄弟,不,苏镇长,你别和我一般见识,我这人就是野惯了,想到什么说什么。等兄弟到了黑山镇报到,我就请苏镇长大喝一场,你一定要给我这个面子。”
“好说!”苏沐笑道,从心里面他并不讨厌徐炎。一个能在危急关头挺身而出的人,再坏能坏到哪里?更何况徐炎还是黑山镇派出所的副所长,他惊讶自己年轻这很正常,但自己有何尝不吃惊于他。
二十五岁便成为黑山镇派出所副所长,绝对的实权人物,比自己这个副镇长不知道要强出多少!
如果说徐炎没有什么后台,苏沐肯定不信!
可惜的是现在的官榜,没有办法通过身体接触,直接显现出对方的家庭背景,真要能做到这个,那就实在太爽了。
“大家都不要慌,我是黑山镇副镇长苏沐,这位是咱们黑山镇派出所的徐炎所长,这几个小毛贼等到下车的时候,会依法处置的。你们安心坐着就成!司机师傅,开车吧!”苏沐扫过车厢微笑道。
“好样的!”
“苏镇长,俺认识你。”
“徐所长,厉害啊!”
......
在众人的欢呼声中,长途汽车很为费劲的开到了黑山镇。下车后,有着几个青壮劳力没有离开,瞧着刀疤脸四个,冲着徐炎问道:“苏镇长,要不要帮忙,将这四个人渣弄到派出所去?”
“不必了!有我在,他们跑不了。”徐炎大手一挥道。
“小子,真以为你打倒老子,就能为所欲为。实话告诉你,只要我一个电话,你就得乖乖的将老子放出来。识相的话你就趁早,别让老子动手。不然等到老子离开派出所,非好好收拾收拾你。”刀疤脸恶狠狠道。
“在这黑山镇,还没有什么人敢得罪我刀疤,你也不例外!”
**裸的恐吓!
“行啊小子,都到这地步了,还嘴硬。我倒要看看今天谁能把你带走,全都站起来给我走!”徐炎不为所动大声道。

苏沐瞧着刀疤脸的眼神,眉头不由微微一皱。和徐炎初来乍到不同,他好歹在这黑山镇已经工作了半年,对这里的门道倒也有所了解。刀疤脸既然敢放狠话,难不成他的背后真有人?
不过瞧徐炎的样子,倒是满不在乎。或许真的如同徐炎所说,他有着收拾刀疤脸的实力。不管了,就冲着徐炎这个豪爽的性格,苏沐决定了,这件事他会管到底。还就不信了,几个劫匪都敢这么猖狂!
“徐炎,知道路?”苏沐笑道:“瞧你那眼神也知道够呛,走吧,我带路,将这几个家伙先关押起来。”
“哈哈,苏镇长那就有劳了。抢劫,袭警,就这两项我就能让你们把牢底坐穿!”徐炎大笑道。
黑山镇原本就没多大,夹在山峰间的这处空地呈狭窄条状。苏沐将徐炎领到派出所后,没有多做停留便转身离开。该做的他都做了,剩下的事情就全靠徐炎了。
至于进派出所苏沐是压根没想过,原因很简单,这里是镇长的自留地。黑山镇虽然贫穷落后,但只要有人的地方就有斗争,这句话是一点都不假。镇长杨松把持着派出所,将这里经营的水都泼不进去。
别说是苏沐这种有职无权的副镇长,哪怕是镇委书记梁昌贵想要调动派出所都要看杨松的心情。
没办法,谁让这派出所的所长杨虎,是杨松的亲侄子。,
话说到这里,就要交代下黑山镇的基本情况。镇委书记梁昌贵是土生土长的本地人,位高权重。平日里就是说一不二的狠角色,在黑山镇所辖十个自然村,没有谁不知道梁昌贵的大名。那些个村支书,有好几个都是梁昌贵看着长大的。
现年五十岁的梁昌贵,对黑山镇拥有着绝对的话语权。
稍微提下,苏沐之所以能够从县委政府办进入黑山镇当上这个副镇长,便是走的梁昌贵的门路。真要细算的话,苏沐的老娘和梁昌贵还能拉扯上亲戚关系。

content_en:
——————————————
Xu Yan really didn't expect that Su Mu, who was smoking and chatting with him all the way, would be the deputy mayor of Heishan Town? Wait, how old is he, how can he become a deputy section-level cadre?
"Brother, you didn't lie to me, did you?" Xu Yan said with a smile.
"Is there any benefit to lying to you?" Su Mu said calmly: "Besides, my identity can be found out by just checking it when I arrive in Black Mountain Town. Is it okay to lie to you now?"
"That's true!" Xu Yan touched his head and said with a smile: "Brother, no, Mayor Su, don't be on the same level as me. I am just a wild person. I will say whatever comes to my mind. When brother reports to Heishan Town, I will invite Mayor Su for a drink. You must give me this face."
"Easy to say!" Su Mu said with a smile. From the bottom of his heart, he didn't hate Xu Yan. How bad can a person who can step forward in a critical moment be? What's more, Xu Yan is also the deputy director of the Heishan Town Police Station. It's normal for him to be surprised at his young age, but why shouldn't he be surprised by him?
At the age of twenty-five, he became the deputy director of the Heishan Town Police Station. He was an absolutely powerful figure, and he was infinitely more powerful than the deputy mayor himself!
If you say that Xu Yan has no background, Su Mu will definitely not believe it!
It's a pity that in the current official list, there is no way to directly reveal the other person's family background through physical contact. It would be really cool to be able to do this.
"Don't panic, everyone. I am Su Mu, the deputy mayor of Heishan Town. This is Director Xu Yan of our Heishan Town Police Station. These little thieves will be dealt with according to the law when they get off the car. Just sit back and relax! Driver, drive!" Su Mu said with a smile as he glanced across the car.
"Well done!"
"Mayor Su, I know you."
"Director Xu, you are awesome!"
...
In the cheers of everyone, the long-distance bus drove to Heishan Town with great difficulty. After getting off the car, a few young and strong laborers stayed. Looking at the four scar-faced men, they asked Xu Yan: "Mayor Su, do you want to help us get these four scumbags to the police station?"
"No need! As long as I'm here, they can't run away." Xu Yan waved his hand.
"Boy, I really think you can do whatever you want if you knock me down. To tell you the truth, as long as I give you a call, you have to release me obediently. If you know the truth, you should do it before I do it. Otherwise, when I leave the police station, I will take care of you." Scarface said fiercely.
"In this Black Mountain Town, no one dares to offend me, Scar, and you are no exception!"
**Naked threats!
"Okay, boy, you've come to this point and you're still being stubborn. I want to see who can take you away today. Everyone stand up and let me go!" Xu Yan said loudly, unmoved.
Su Mu looked at the scarred face and frowned slightly. Unlike Xu Yan, who had just arrived, he had been working in Heishan Town for half a year, and he had some knowledge of the ways here. Since Scarface dares to say harsh words, is there really someone behind him?
But looking at Xu Yan's appearance, he didn't care. Perhaps as Xu Yan said, he has the strength to clean up Scarface. Regardless, because of Xu Yan's bold character, Su Mu decided that he would take care of this matter to the end. I still can’t believe how many robbers dare to be so rampant!
"Xu Yan, do you know the way?" Su Mu said with a smile: "Looking at the look in your eyes, I know it's scary. Let's go. I will lead the way and lock these guys up first."
"Haha, Mayor Su, you'll have a hard time. Robbery and assault on the police, just these two items I can make you sit in jail!" Xu Yan laughed.
Black Mountain Town was originally not that big, and the open space sandwiched between the peaks was in the shape of a narrow strip. After Su Mu led Xu Yan to the police station, he turned around and left without stopping. He did everything he had to do, and the rest was all up to Xu Yan.
As for entering the police station, Su Mu never thought about it. The reason is very simple. This is the mayor's place.Private plot. Although Heishan Town is poor and backward, wherever there are people, there is struggle. This saying is not false at all. The mayor of the town, Yang Song, controls the police station and prevents the operation of the place from getting in.
Let alone a deputy mayor like Su Mu who has no authority but Liang Changgui, the secretary of the town committee, if he wants to transfer the police station, it depends on Yang Song's mood.
There is no way, who knows that the director of this police station, Yang Hu, is Yang Song's nephew. ,
Having said that, we need to explain the basic situation of Heishan Town. Liang Changgui, secretary of the town committee, is a native and holds a high position of authority. He is a ruthless character who is always good at talking. In the ten natural villages under the jurisdiction of Heishan Town, no one does not know Liang Changgui's name. Liang Changgui watched several of those village party secretaries grow up.
Liang Changgui, now fifty years old, has absolute say in Heishan Town.
To mention a little bit, the reason why Su Mu was able to enter Heishan Town from the county party committee government office and become the deputy mayor was because he followed Liang Changgui's path. If we really want to calculate carefully, Su Mu's mother and Liang Changgui can still be related to each other.
